第21章 筑基期灵兽与上品灵药（第1页）
五位浑身裹在黑袍内之人，正围坐在一道篝火旁。
“此事宜早不宜迟，现在就行动！”
其中一位黑袍人取出了一面水晶镜子，镜面内是一幅地图，其上有三道红点正在移动。
下一秒，五位黑袍人便消失在山洞，篝火被掠过的风直接吹灭。
南风森林中部区域，林地间一片空地。
一头两米高，满嘴尖牙的灵兽黑牙兔哀鸣倒下。
看着手环跳出的信息，张云向正站在黑牙兔身旁，喘着粗气的吴小胖报以肯定目光：“干得不错！”
这头黑牙兔是炼气期八重的修为，他虽已炼气期巅峰，但战斗经验不足，费了好一番功夫才解决！
张云看了眼手环上的数字，略感好奇。
算算时间，眼下距离两宗交流会开始，已经差不多一个时辰。
毕竟开始时，跟邱略三人战斗耽误了不少时间。不过之后通过邱略这份路线图，找灵兽倒是便捷许多。
“不管现在是第几，三日后争取拿下第一！”
参与这两宗交流会，他目标就是第一。
化婴丹不说，这还关乎着本年度的灵仙宗长老排名！
要能拿下第一，那他本年度的长老成绩就会大大提升，之后保下长老之位就有很大希望了！
继续按照路线图，找向下一处灵兽地点。
这一回找到地方后，张云眉头一扬。

这是森林内的一处湖泊，湖面上飘着十多条身长两三米的鳄鱼。
先前都是一两头，这下倒好，一群！
看着跃跃欲试的徐鸣和吴小胖，张云摆了摆手，当即准备走出。
突然，前方湖泊传出了一声低沉的嘶吼，只见一条身长超过五米的巨鳄从湖下探出身躯。
弱点：鼻子与腹部十分脆弱，攻击这两处可快速使其重伤……
进入南风森林这么半天，还是第一回碰上筑基期灵兽。
就在他靠近到接近湖泊十米处时，湖面上的灵鳄王明显有所感应，那一双凶戾的瞳孔直视过来。
看到他这位入侵者顿时一声嘶吼，庞大身躯三两下游出湖泊，张起血盆大嘴就朝他扑咬过来。
身躯虽庞大，但这灵鳄王速度却一点不慢，顷刻间便冲到他身前。

Chapter 21 Spiritual beasts and high-grade elixirs in the foundation-building period (page 1)
Five people wrapped in black robes were sitting around a bonfire.
“This matter should be taken sooner rather than later, act now!”
One of the men in black robes took out a crystal mirror. Inside the mirror was a map with three red dots moving on it.
The next second, the five men in black robes disappeared into the cave, and the bonfire was blown out by the passing wind.
In the central area of ​​Nanfeng Forest, there is a clearing among the woodlands.
A black-toothed rabbit, a two-meter-tall spiritual beast with a mouth full of fangs, fell down with a cry.
Looking at the message that popped up on the bracelet, Zhang Yun looked affirmatively at Fatty Wu, who was standing next to Black Tooth Rabbit and breathing heavily: "Well done!"
This black-toothed rabbit was at the eighth level of the Qi Refining Stage. Although he was at the peak of the Qi Refining Stage, he lacked combat experience and it took a lot of effort to solve it!
Zhang Yun looked at the numbers on the bracelet and felt a little curious.
Counting the time, it has been almost an hour since the exchange meeting between the two sects started.
After all, at the beginning, the battle with Qiu Lue and the others took a lot of time. However, after using Qiu Lue's road map, it was much easier to find spiritual beasts.
"No matter where we are now, we will try to get the first place in three days!"
When participating in these two exchange meetings, his goal was to be number one.
Not to mention the Infant Transformation Pill, this is also related to this year’s ranking of Lingxian Sect elders!
If he can get first place, his performance as an elder this year will be greatly improved, and he will have great hope of retaining his position as an elder in the future!
Continue to follow the route map to find the next spiritual beast location.
After finding the place this time, Zhang Yun raised his eyebrows.
This is a lake in the forest, with more than a dozen crocodiles two to three meters long floating on the lake.
Previously there were just one or two, but now it’s a group!
Looking at Xu Ming and Wu Xiaopang who were eager to try, Zhang Yun waved his hand and was about to walk out.
Suddenly, a deep roar came from the lake in front, and a giant crocodile more than five meters long was seen leaning out from the bottom of the lake.
Weaknesses: The nose and abdomen are very fragile. Attacking these two places can quickly cause severe injuries...
After entering the Nanfeng Forest for so long, this was the first time I encountered a foundation-building spiritual beast.
Just when he was ten meters away from the lake, the Spirit Crocodile King on the lake clearly sensed something, and his ferocious pupils looked directly at him.
Seeing him, the intruder immediately let out a roar, and his huge body swam out of the lake in twos and twos, opening his bloody mouth and pounced on him.
Although his body was huge, the Spirit Crocodile King was not slow at all and rushed in front of him in an instant.
